result:
`billingUrl` is now `billingEndpoint` everywhere, with the same value, and the change is live. PR #1 passed CI, merged, and CD succeeded. I've marked the ticket done.

- **One PR instead of three:** `libs/shared-contracts` is inlined into the apps at build time. It isn't published to the registry, so there was no separate release or dependency update to do. Splitting the work would also have left the build broken between merges. PR #1 covers all three sub-tasks.
- **Extra app changed:** `apps/sub-route-reports` also read `billingUrl`, though the ticket doesn't list it. I updated it too, since leaving it would have broken the "no reference remains" criterion and the app's startup log.
- **Version bump:** I bumped `shared-contracts` to 2.0.0 because the rename is breaking. It's harmless for an inlined lib, and I'll mention it in case you'd rather not have it.
- **Nothing else surprised me.** I did not start the apps myself. The "every live app still starts up" criterion rests on the green CI build.

The `st pr open --help` call I tried first failed with an error from the `st` script, so I used `st help` instead.
